label: cardinal numerals to one hundred: a price, an age, a house number
note: Half taught, and the missing half is named. Six to twenty is covered (MR-A1-QU-02, chapters 55-58) and one hundred is not: viis is the ceiling, so the TENS -- tiis, chaaLiis, pannaas, saaTH, sattar, aiMshii, navvad -- and shambhar are the whole of what is left, plus the rule that a unit fuses onto the front of a ten. It is still demanded four times over by the A1 envelope, and it still blocks MR-A1-NG5-04, MR-A1-NG6-02, MR-A1-NE03-01 and MR-A1-F1-03. One of those tens, aiMshii, additionally needs the INDEPENDENT ai of MR-A1-OR-12, which is a different debt from the ai SIGN this tranche paid.
